study_id.description: Slug of the study this round advances. Required: a round never invents or infers one, because a round that opens the wrong study spends a real budget against the wrong plan.

target.description: Optional target Hugging Face model ID or deployed Kubernetes service name.

namespace.description: Optional target Kubernetes namespace for GKE deployment and profiling.

bundle_dir.description: Optional path to a distributed serving (llm-d) Kustomize bundle directory.

kubeconfig.description: Optional kubeconfig path for target GKE cluster access.

context.description: Optional Kubernetes context name for target GKE cluster access.

service_url.description: Optional explicit serving endpoint URL for distributed serving benchmarks.

mode.description: Optional study approval mode matching study-protocol.json ('approve' or 'auto').

baseline_metrics.description: Optional path to an onboarding-metrics.json or baseline.json artifact to reuse as the baseline measurement.

levers.description: Optional empirical bottleneck lever IDs identified during profiling.

protocol.description: Optional inline Study Protocol conforming to framework/schemas/study-protocol.json.

protocol_path.description: Optional path to the pre-registered study-protocol.json (protocol.json) artifact compiled during query intake.

hardware_budget.description: Optional TPU slice budget for the study loop.

traffic_profile.description: Optional benchmark traffic shape for the study loop.

examples.prompt: Onboard Qwen 3.5 on GKE TPU v7x and optimize throughput for AgentX
